title: Pro Shop Store Credit: refund and closure-settlement basis (retired)
content:
## Basis
This policy formerly governed two related grounds for a Pro Shop Store Credit account: (1) a refund of a top-up could be recorded only while the account sat in active status, or in the same moment as its confirmed cancellation to closed, and only when the member requested it before the tier's own refund window had elapsed since that top-up, counted in full calendar days; and (2) at closure, an unused balance at or above the tier's own smallest refund-eligible balance was refunded at the tier's own refund percentage, while a balance below that floor was instead forfeited under the tier's own forfeiture percentage.

All of the grounds above are no longer in force. The current basis for when a top-up is reversed, for whether a redemption-driven refund request is honoured, and for how a closing account's remaining balance is settled — including how a member's standing elsewhere affects each of these — is governed elsewhere.

## Points of judgement
- Neither the account-status-and-window ground for a top-up refund, nor the balance-threshold ground for a closure settlement, may still be applied as this policy's own basis; both have been superseded.
- The tier's own refund window, refund percentage, smallest refund-eligible balance and forfeiture percentage remain valid tier parameters in their own right, even though the handling grounds that formerly read them here are no longer in force.

superseded_clauses: only when requested before refund_window_days have elapsed since that top-up, counted as full calendar days with no partial-day rounding

A refund of a top-up may be recorded only while the account is active or in the same moment as its confirmed cancellation to closed, and only when requested before refund_window_days have elapsed since that top-up, counted as full calendar days with no partial-day rounding

at closure, an unused balance at or above minimum_closure_refund_usd is refunded at refund_pct, and a balance below minimum_closure_refund_usd is forfeited under unused_balance_forfeiture_on_closure_pct
